meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 你请它做演示文稿时,它会把内容编排成 HyperFrames 幻灯片:每页独立成场景,支持逐段揭示、点击热点跳转分支、演示者模式与演讲者备注,也能把现有网页改造成幻灯片。产出是可操作的演示,不是视频文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“slideshow”“slide show”“HyperFrames slideshow”等词,或要求做演示文稿、pitch deck、interactive deck 等,或要求把页面转成幻灯片时触发;类似请求但没明确要幻灯片时,它会先确认。

say.text: 把这个产品页面转成一页页幻灯片,保留原样设计
say.note: 它会先确认再转换,保留交互和动画

say.text: 做一个 5 页的 pitch deck,每页带演讲者备注
say.note: 生成可导航的演示,按你确认的提纲分页

say.text: 在第三页加一个热点,点击跳到市场细分的分支页
say.note: 热点会作为可点击按钮,触发分支序列

howto.what_en: It builds a HyperFrames slideshow: each slide is a scene with fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode and speaker notes; it can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slide show, slideshow, or HyperFrames slideshow, or for a presentation/pitch deck/interactive deck; similar requests get a confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a slide deck, keeping the design.
say_en.note: It confirms first, then preserves interactions and motion.

say_en.text: Make a 5-slide pitch deck with speaker notes on each slide.
say_en.note: It generates a navigable deck based on the outline you approve.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to the market-detail branch.
say_en.note: The hotspot becomes a clickable button triggering that branch.
